actions.action_type: official TID No. 5 project status page
actions.result_status: The official TID No. 5 page lists Microsoft data center Area 3B as set for operation in 2026, Microsoft data center Area 3A as set for completion in 2028, and Microsoft future data center development in Area II and the North Area. The page corroborates a phased campus rather than full buildout.
actions.access_caveat: Official project-status web page accessed during refresh; it is not a building-level permit, certificate of occupancy, or utility energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Local-government corroboration for phased status: Area 3B operation target, Area 3A 2028 completion target, and additional future development.

actions.government_body: Village of Mount Pleasant Community Development Authority
actions.result_status: Official CDA minutes record discussion of Microsoft purchase/sale and development agreements covering additional land in Areas 2 and 3. The minutes do not record approval by the CDA and are not treated as a board vote.
actions.access_caveat: Discussion minutes; subsequent Village/County actions are not reconstructed from this item.
actions.evidence_note: Official local record of agreement process, not approval.

actions.government_body: Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation / Wisconsin Department of Revenue
actions.result_status: Wisconsin's official qualified-data-center list identifies Microsoft at 90th Street, Mount Pleasant, certified 2023-10-01 and described as to be constructed. Certification is a tax-exemption eligibility record, not a building permit or CO.
actions.access_caveat: State tax certification page; it does not give building-level permit or energization status.
actions.evidence_note: Government tax record tying Microsoft to the Mount Pleasant site.

actions.result_status: The official TID report says Microsoft began construction of the first phase in 2024, with completion expected mid-2026, and describes additional agreements and a second phase announced for 2028. This is municipal financial/reporting context, not a CO.
actions.access_caveat: Annual report summarizes project activity and projections; it does not provide the complete permit/inspection register.

actions.government_body: Microsoft / Village of Mount Pleasant (company announcement)
actions.result_status: Microsoft announced the first Mount Pleasant facility completed and fully operational after equipment was brought online and startup activities occurred in April. The same release says the second adjacent facility remains under construction and is scheduled for 2028; no full-campus completion is claimed.
actions.access_caveat: Company operational announcement; no government CO or independent energization record was located.
actions.evidence_note: Operational claim is limited to first facility; second facility explicitly remains under construction.
